character: Courchevel is a set of villages — 1850, Moriond (1650), Village (1550) and Le Praz (1300), with neighbouring La Tania — on the eastern side of Les 3 Vallées, with about 150 km of its own pistes. It links to Méribel over La Saulire and on to Val Thorens and Les Menuires in the 600 km 3 Vallées area, and Courchevel 1850 is one of the Alps' best-known upmarket resorts.
learning: Reference: Courchevel has well-known beginner zones near 1850 and 1650 and many blue runs; confirm which beginner lifts are free or discounted and book lessons early for holiday weeks.
